+

+base64 -d mimo_build_env.tar.gz.b64 | tar -xzf - -C /testbed || exit 1
+exec bash -lc 'cd /testbed && bash -eo pipefail /testbed/.build_env/test_command.sh'
diff --git a/libcst/_nodes/tests/test_repair_fstring_py37.py b/libcst/_nodes/tests/test_repair_fstring_py37.py
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/libcst/_nodes/tests/test_repair_fstring_py37.py
@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+import libcst as cst
+
+
+def test_fstring_generator_expressions_parse_under_py37_and_py38():
+    for version in ('3.6', '3.7', '3.8'):
+        cfg = cst.PartialParserConfig(python_version=version)
+        expr = cst.parse_expression('f"{x for x in y}"', config=cfg)
+        assert isinstance(expr, cst.FormattedString)
+        mod = cst.parse_module('x = f"{i * 2 for i in range(3)}"\n', config=cfg)
+        assert mod.code == 'x = f"{i * 2 for i in range(3)}"\n'

(
bash /testbed/mimo_test_command.sh
)
REPAIR_RC=$?
cd /testbed || exit 1
if [ -x /opt/test_venv/bin/python3 ]; then
  PATH=/opt/test_venv/bin:$PATH
  export PATH
  python() { /opt/test_venv/bin/python3 "$@"; }
  python3() { /opt/test_venv/bin/python3 "$@"; }
fi
/testbed/.venv/bin/python -m pytest libcst/_nodes/tests/test_repair_fstring_py37.py -q
REPAIR_NEW_RC=$?
if [ "$REPAIR_NEW_RC" -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi
exit "$REPAIR_RC"
